steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Ghost admin at http://127.0.0.1:8099/ghost/ using email admin@bench.local and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}. Verify that the admin interface is signed in and report the visible page.
02-find: In Ghost admin, find and report the exact titles of all published posts whose title starts with 'Seed:'. Do not edit or publish anything; verify they are published.

03-create: Create and publish one public Ghost post titled '{{runid}} Bench Post'. Its body must contain exactly one paragraph that includes the text '{{runid}}'. Set its only tag by selecting the existing suggested tag 'Bench News' (not Bench Newsletter and do not create a tag). In post settings set a custom excerpt including '{{runid}}' and obtain/report the exact URL slug shown in settings. Set the publish date to 2026-09-01, but ensure the post is published now and public rather than left draft or scheduled; complete Ghost's final publish confirmation flow. Verify and report saved title, body paragraph, sole tag, excerpt, slug, public visibility/status, and publish date.
